what: Spectral sodium shading (web/shaders/sodium): GPU pass against the float64 CPU reference
source: Sodium Quay G-buffers at 192 x 108; the same f32 G-buffer and the same f64 response table (as f32) feed both sides
why: Shading is a sum of products of f32 table entries and smooth geometric terms; f32 against f64 moves values by rounding only.
